admin_sso_config.title: Login & Single Sign-On (SSO)
admin_sso_config.subtitle: Configure authentication rules, connect enterprise Identity Providers (Google / Entra ID / SAML), manage verified corporate domains, and set emergency access policies.

policy.title: Authentication Policies & Enforcement
policy.subtitle: Control internal password access, mandatory SSO routing, and automated user provisioning settings.
policy.allowPasswordLoginDesc: When enabled, internal team members can sign in using their email address and password.
policy.jitProvisioningDesc: Automatically create a user account when an authorized employee logs in via SSO for the first time.
policy.optionalSsoDesc: Users can freely choose to log in via either standard password or any enabled Identity Provider.
policy.mandatorySsoDesc: Password login is disabled for users with corporate email domains matching verified SSO domains.

providers.title: Configured Identity Providers
providers.subtitle: Configure OAuth2 / OIDC credentials and SAML metadata for your corporate Identity Providers.

google.name: Google Workspace
google.desc: Allow internal employees to sign in seamlessly using their Google Workspace or G Suite accounts.

entra.name: Microsoft Entra ID
entra.desc: Authenticate staff via Microsoft 365, Azure Active Directory, or corporate Entra ID app registrations.

saml.name: Enterprise SAML 2.0 / OIDC
saml.desc: Connect custom enterprise identity providers including Okta, PingIdentity, OneLogin, or custom SAML.

domains.title: Corporate Domain Routing & Verification
domains.subtitle: Verified email domains automatically redirect users entering their email during login to your configured SSO provider.

safeguards.title: Emergency Access & Security Safeguards
safeguards.subtitle: Configure break-glass admin accounts to prevent tenant lockout if your Identity Provider suffers an outage.
safeguards.breakGlassDesc: Designated emergency admin accounts retain password authentication access even when Mandatory SSO is enforced.
safeguards.revokeSessionsDesc: Immediately terminate all active SSO user sessions across the entire platform. Users will be prompted to re-authenticate.
safeguards.revokeSuccess: All active SSO sessions have been revoked.

drawer.title: Configure {{provider}}
drawer.enableAuthDesc: Activate or suspend SSO logins for this provider
drawer.clientIdPlaceholder: Enter Client ID from Identity Provider
drawer.connectFailed: Connection failed: Please enter a valid Client ID or Metadata URL.
